observations: Photo 0: White Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine on a bed; blue touchscreen/control panel visible.
Photo 0: Brand name “brother” visible on the machine body.

claims.claim: Upgrade your sewing and embroidery projects with this Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and...
claims.evidence: The photos show a Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine with a touchscreen, but the specific model “SE630” is not readable in either photo.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk (SE630 vs another Brother computerized/embroidery model). This affects value and parts/accessories compatibility.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model label/plate (usually on the side/back/bottom) showing “SE630” exactly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine (worst case vs SE630-specific pricing).

risks.risk: Not tested / may not sew or embroider correctly (stitching, tension, motor, embroidery functions).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of it sewing a straight line and a short embroidery pattern (on fabric) with the screen showing the selected stitch/pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (needles, bobbins, presser feet, embroidery hoop(s), USB/cords, power adapter, manual).
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of everything included: needles, bobbins, feet, hoops, power cable, any USB/software, and manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Condition risk (screen damage, cracked plastic, rusted/dirty needle area, worn internal parts). Photos don’t show close inspection.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: needle area, presser foot area, underside/bottom, and touchscreen surface (no glare) plus any visible wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for used units.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate showing “SE630”.
Video: straight stitch test on fabric (showing stitch selection on screen).
Video: embroidery test (show a short pattern running to completion).
Photo/video of all included accessories (needles, bobbins, presser feet, embroidery hoops, power cable, manual/USB if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine, but the specific model “SE630” and working condition/accessories are not verifiable from the provided images, so a reliable price pick isn’t safe yet.
